name: V&G 220°C Heat Protection Conditioning Mist 100ml - Keep Your Hair Protected and Beautiful
description:
Product details of V&G Heat Protection Conditioning Mist – 100ml (Up to 220°C)

Product Type: Heat Protection Spray / Conditioning Mist

Size: 100ml

Heat Protection: Up to 220°C

Suitable For: All hair types, especially frizz-prone hair

Key Features:

Protects & Nourishes: Forms a protective barrier between heat and hair, leaving hair smooth, shiny, and manageable

Strengthens Hair: Active ingredients nourish, strengthen, and restore hair’s natural shine

Lightweight & Non-Greasy: Delivers flexible hold without weighing hair down

Easy to Use:

Press button to release mist

Spray 8–15cm from damp hair

Comb through and blow dry with a round brush

For extra volume, focus on roots and blow dry hair upside down

Ideal for maintaining healthy, frizz-free, salon-quality hair
